authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 125 aṅgāra explicitly lists Gawri, Kalasha, Khowar aṅgār, Bshk äṅgār, Maiya agār and Palula aṅgōr in the fire/charcoal family. These survey velar-nasal and vowel variants match the explicitly attested northern fire word. Previously reviewed comparator: Mai āgār “fire” (f_vu3hdyxfoqt5a). Exact survey transcription remains unchanged.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3696 kṣīra explicitly gives Kalasha/Khowar c̣hir and Bshk c̣hīr milk. The survey retroflex affricate notation and variable aspiration identify that milk family, with final rhotic articulation retained. Previously reviewed comparator: Kho ʦ̣hīr “milk” (f_sy42p3dw64kug). Exact survey transcription remains unchanged.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10702 rātrī lists Bshk rāt, Kalasha rat and K. rāth night. The rāt/rōt responses, including final aspiration, fit the night family; initial ə- and loss of the final stop require comparison with alternative formations. Previously reviewed comparator: Bshk rāt “night” (f_4j5bwmfezbyws). Exact survey transcription remains unchanged.
